purpose: implementation, intervention-coverage, and safety pilot for three fixed first-run ranking baselines; not validation evidence

requirements: a first-run policy-eligible root decision exists in the leakage-safe observational view
source trace elapsed time is below 10 seconds
the local MPS file exists and matches the recorded SHA-256
the instance was not used by the first-run pilot or cohorts A, B, or C
official MIPLIB Group is nonempty and distinct within this pilot
selection_contract.sampling: complete enumeration of all five instances satisfying the requirements; no active treatment outcome was used
selection_contract.role: development pilot only; outcomes may determine whether a larger train cohort is worth running but cannot support validation or test claims

experiment_contract.process_isolation: one fresh Python/SCIP process per instance, seed, and arm
experiment_contract.selected_cut_budget: each fixed baseline preserves native hybrid selected-cut count and leaves forced cuts untouched
experiment_contract.primary_metric: PAR-2 penalized solving-time ratio, aggregated over seeds and then instances
experiment_contract.analysis_command: scip-cut-trace-v2-paper-stats with 10000 cluster-bootstrap replicates and seed 20260717

checks_per_action: all five native arms complete for all three seeds
actual selected-set changes occur on at least three instances
instance-equal penalized-time point ratio is below 1.0
pilot_gate.selection_rule: among actions passing every pilot check, choose the smallest penalized-time ratio; ties are resolved in the fixed order efficacy-rank, adaptive-score, random-rank
pilot_gate.passing_consequence: pre-register a larger, disjoint train cohort; does not authorize validation or test
pilot_gate.failure_consequence: do not enlarge or tune the failed action on these outcomes
